courses.title: Recruitment and Selection Best Practices
courses.description: By the end of Recruitment and Selection Best Practices, you'll be able to apply recruitment and selection confidently in HR Manager work, with a working sense of where hr policy design fits alongside it. The course moves from core recruitment and selection technique through a few applied exercises, with a lighter look at hr policy design woven in throughout.
learning_outcomes: Applying recruitment and selection to a real HR Manager scenario
Practicing recruitment and selection through guided exercises
Getting a working introduction to hr policy design
Reviewing common mistakes and how to avoid them

courses.title: Diversity and Inclusion Practices in Practice
courses.description: Diversity and Inclusion Practices in Practice is a focused course on diversity and inclusion practices for people already working toward a HR Manager role who want to go further. You'll work through applied exercises that push past the basics and into more realistic scenarios, with less hand-holding than an introductory course. By the end, you should feel noticeably more confident applying diversity and inclusion practices on your own.
